### encoder-real-operating-point-bench-gate

<EvidenceAnchor id="cov-c2991196-real-operating-point" />

- **Coverage ID:** `cov-c2991196-real-operating-point`
- **Status:** OPEN

**Reason:** The design's real operating point differs from every retained spec test condition. V3P3's 10 kOhm pull-up gives roughly 0.33 mA closed-contact current versus the retained 5 V/5 kOhm chatter-bounce test circuit. The only retained minimum-current spec, 500 uA, belongs to the unused D/E push switch, not the A/B/C rotary contacts, so no retained wetting-current minimum covers the rotary path. C22/C23 100 nF at ENC\_A/ENC\_B discharge through R27/R28 100 Ohm at roughly 33 mA peak with no retained contact-current rating for that transient. Bench debounce and contact verification at the real 3.3 V/10k operating point is required before this domain can close.
